scenario_name: Management Plane Hardening: Telnet to SSH Migration
base_template: Write a security audit report (3-4 sentences) for {{company_domain}}. Explain that an attacker captured clear-text credentials on {{router_name}} because Telnet was used. Demand a migration to SSH v2 with a {{timeout}} minute timeout and {{retries}} max attempts.

company_domain.instruction: Generate a professional domain (e.g. net-ops.io, secure-core.com)

router_name.instruction: Generate a router hostname like Core-R1 or Border-GW

expected_solution: Generate RSA keys, 'ip ssh version 2', set 'exec-timeout', and 'transport input ssh' on VTY lines.
